'''Odumis Mer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Odumis Mer was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Mer was appointed as the security chief of the village during the pilgrim's second decade on the planet. Angered at the increased [[Flesh Raider]] attacks on the camp, Mer desired to obtain an [[Flesh Raider elixir|elixir]] used by the Flesh Raiders to make them stronger. Mer intended to feed the elixir to his warriors with the intent of destroying the Flesh Raiders.<ref name="TOR" />
